metaTitle: Placement Assistance | IT Job Readiness — Ask4Trainings Hyderabad
metaDescription: Resume review, mock interviews, and hiring-partner referrals for students targeting Guidewire, SAP, Cloud, DevOps, and full-stack roles.
heroSubtitle: From resume polish to mock interviews and hiring-partner referrals — our placement cell helps you convert training into a job-ready profile.
introBody: Placement support is included with our job-oriented programmes. We focus on interview readiness for enterprise roles in Hyderabad and remote/global hiring pipelines.

technologies.title: Resume & LinkedIn
technologies.desc: Role-specific resume rewrite and LinkedIn positioning aligned to target designations in Guidewire, SAP, and Cloud domains.

technologies.title: Technical Mocks
technologies.desc: Domain-specific mock interviews conducted by practicing professionals. Guidewire, SAP, DevOps, Oracle rounds covered.

technologies.title: Hiring Partner Referrals
technologies.desc: Direct referrals to our network of hiring partners — service companies, product firms, and insurance carriers.

technologies.title: Soft Skills & Interview Coaching
technologies.desc: Communication coaching, HR round preparation, salary negotiation tips, and offer acceptance guidance.

processSteps.title: Profile Audit
processSteps.desc: We review your resume, experience, and target role after core modules are complete.

processSteps.title: Resume & LinkedIn Revamp
processSteps.desc: Our placement team rewrites your resume and optimizes your LinkedIn for ATS and recruiter discoverability.

processSteps.title: Mock Interview Rounds
processSteps.desc: 2–3 rounds of technical mock interviews with industry experts. Detailed feedback after each round.

processSteps.title: Referral & Follow-Up
processSteps.desc: We connect you with hiring partners and follow up until you receive and accept an offer.

formSubtitle: Share your course, experience level, and target role. A counsellor will call you back within 2 hours.
